name: [D1] Use the supplied supervisor phase settings during routing (M)
description:
Use the supplied supervisor phase settings during routing

Location: src/ovcaq/config.py; src/ovcaq/runtime/supervisor.py; tests/workflow/test_supervisor_configuration.py; tests/runtime/test_supervisor.py

Reuse: existing StateStore/StateService, pure decisions, shared runtime ownership and test fixtures.

Contract (source requirement/design excerpts):
`supervisor_settings(..., **explicit)` accepts exactly `runtime` as a
`RuntimeSettings`, `policy` as a `SupervisorPolicy`, and `phases` as a complete
build/review/done mapping of `PhaseSettings`; each replaces the corresponding
resolved section.

Details:
Ensure a validated SupervisorSettings.phases override supplied to Supervisor actually controls tier, effort and timeout used in LaunchRequest. Reuse resolved settings rather than re-reading configuration twice for each phase. Preserve agent-specific tier/effort precedence, prompt literals, supported public configuration inputs and provider-neutral resolved concrete model values. Prefer a small internal resolver/helper over an unnecessary public signature redesign. F14/F15 were discarded: do not pass a tier in the concrete-model field or change the accepted logical tier defaults.

### Findings (verbatim)
- 🟡 Nothing in `src/` reads `SupervisorSettings.phases`. The supervisor routes through `resolve_phase_route(root, …)`, which rebuilds settings from disk (parsing both TOML files twice per call). So the validated `phases=` override and the `**explicit: object` runtime type checks in `supervisor_settings` only matter to tests | File: src/ovcaq/config.py:512 | Consensus: [1/3]

Acceptance criteria:
- Every quoted finding no longer reproduces.
- Every decision is explainable from committed state plus summary.
- Metrics, pause, stop, retry, park, and halt contracts pass.
- Required post-drain capability lifecycle and independent retry pass.

Verify: tests fail for the quoted regression before implementation and pass after; run applicable focused tests, source quality gates, and the work skill's mandatory final verification. Do not read live launcher homes in tests.
